Mesh Gradient Generator

Design mesh gradients: four color stops blended as layered radial gradients, with a live preview and copyable CSS.

Mesh Gradient Generator

Four radial-gradient blobs blended into a trendy mesh gradient.

Live preview

Generated CSS


  





  
  


  

    

      
📖 How to use

      
  1. Pick four color stops.
  2. Drag each stop's position sliders to spread the blobs.
  3. Preview the mesh blend live.
  4. Click "Copy CSS" and paste the layered gradient.

    

    

      
❓ Frequently asked questions

      
How many colors can I blend?
Four — each stop is a radial gradient layer blended together for the mesh look.
Is the output plain CSS?
Yes — the snippet is a single background declaration you can paste into any stylesheet.
Is it sharp at any size?
The background is generated with real CSS gradients, so it scales infinitely and never pixelates.
